name: Sea Turtle Remains
summary: Along Darkshore, giant sea turtles lie dead on the coast and beneath the waves. Their remains go to researchers in Auberdine, who study the growing number of strandings.

sections.title: A Disturbing Strand
sections.body: Giant sea creatures are washing ashore along Darkshore, while others lie beneath the water near sunken wrecks. In Auberdine, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde oversees the collection of bone fragments and tissue from the bodies. The Temple of the Moon in Darnassus urgently requests these samples. Its scholars and priestesses fear the creatures may be fleeing an unnatural disturbance in the waters around Teldrassil.

sections.title: Scavengers of the Shallows
sections.body: Recovering the remains is dangerous. Murloc tribes along the coast routinely gather around the huge carcasses, picking bones clean and nesting beside them. Scholars need fresh bone fragments and tissue before the scavengers destroy evidence that could explain the creatures' fatal migration.

faq.q: What are these remains used for?
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde collects the remains in Auberdine and prepares them for scholars and priestesses at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. They are trying to learn why so many ocean creatures are dying along Darkshore.

faq.q: Why are sea turtles beaching themselves in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Researchers have not found the cause, but they fear marine life is fleeing something unsettling in the waters around Teldrassil. The strandings are not isolated incidents; they point to widespread distress among marine life.

aliases: where to find skeletal sea turtle
faq.answer: Giant sea turtle carcasses lie along Darkshore's coast. Some rest in shallow water near sunken ships west of Auberdine, while others litter beaches surrounded by murloc encampments.
Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde collects the remains in Auberdine and sends detailed reports to the Sisterhood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

angles.text: The mass stranding of sea life off your ancestral coast is an ominous sign, especially since the suspected cause lies in the waters encircling Teldrassil.
The unnatural deaths of great sea creatures point to a deeper corruption disturbing nature's balance along the Kalimdor coast.
